protocol: 12 sites, two repeats per source, ABBA/BAAB balanced; same local California egress, ConsentCheckBot HTTP/native Chromium navigator, en-IE/Europe Dublin; fresh independent consent/accept/reject contexts; 30s existing per-lane budgets, no forms/model calls

nomura.com.review: model-assisted visual review; not independent human adjudication

methodology.visualLabels: Primary Codex agent model-assisted visual inspection of all44 usable representative screenshots. No independent human adjudication. Missing Reject on partial inventory is not promoted to verified absence.
methodology.scope: Local scanner control observations/actions, not AWS coordinator or customer API/report projection verification.
methodology.population: Selected diagnostic sites; repeated visits are correlated; not an estimated production defect rate.
methodology.actionRepairs: 15 harness-invalid non-Nomura visit action pairs rerun after corrected parentScanId binding. Repairs are action-only and a distinct stratum, not same-time passive/action observations. No product sources changed during batch.
methodology.cost: No recurring change or scanner model/API calls. Central contact history/export/persistence estimated under $0.10 once. Normal Codex/Luna review usage is separate.
methodology.screenshots: Local captures, not production safety-approved assets.
methodology.handoff: Clock-normalized per CanonicalEvidenceBundle.startedAt versus outer visit.startedAt; zero/submillisecond measurement noise possible.
methodology.actionRates: Descriptive coverage across valid action sessions, replacing known harness-invalid pairs. Passive visible controls are from separate fresh sessions, not proof of identical action-session eligibility; action-only repairs omit passive browser concurrency. No causal action-rate improvement claimed.
methodology.promotion: Selected model-assisted local A/R diagnostic comparison only; not human-adjudicated A/R/O calibration, full six-lane regression, production release gate, or baseline promotion.
